predicate_normalized.note: kernel[UseSubtileImpl] at this point is the post-derivation value: (yaml_UseSubtileImpl AND isgfx950), where isgfx950 = (state[ISA] == IsaVersion(9,5,0)). The predicate is True when the user did NOT request UseSubtileImpl, OR when the target ISA is not gfx950. Canonical: NOT(user_UseSubtileImpl AND (ISA == gfx950)).

derivation_chain.description: UseSubtileImpl declared in defaultBenchmarkCommonParameters with default value False. Valid values are [False, True] (ValidParameters.py:422). The parameter is a solution-level YAML config key.

globalParameters[ISA] defaults to []. The ISA is populated by one of three mutually exclusive paths: (a) --gpu-targets CLI arg parsed in Tensile.py:511,646-653 via gfxToIsa(); (b) config[GlobalParameters][ISA] from YAML (Tensile.py:654-655); (c) detectGlobalCurrentISA(device_id, enumerator) via subprocess call to amdgpu-arch (Tensile.py:658, Architectures.py:257-267) when neither (a) nor (b) is provided.
Solution.__init__ assigns state[ISA] from config[ISA] (if present, set by TensileCreateLibrary path) or targetIsas[0] (derived from isaInfoMap populated from step 2).

Solution.assignDerivedParameters computes isgfx950 = (state[ISA] == IsaVersion(9,5,0)), then overwrites state[UseSubtileImpl] = state[UseSubtileImpl] and isgfx950. This ANDs the user-requested yaml value with the ISA identity check. No asmCaps probe is involved.

setupNewTile receives kernel (a Solution Mapping object) as its first argument. kernel[UseSubtileImpl] reads the already-derived value from step 4. The predicate is True when UseSubtileImpl is False (either user-config False or non-gfx950 ISA forced it to False).

constraints_for_predicate_true.UseSubtileImpl_raw: False (OR ISA != gfx950 so the AND forces False regardless)

notes: The extractor seed def-use was empty ([]). Backward slice was performed by reading Solution.py:811-813 and GlobalParameters/ValidParameters declarations. Two public inputs govern the predicate: (1) UseSubtileImpl yaml parameter (user can set True in solution YAML; default False); (2) ISA, which can arrive via three entry-points (yaml GlobalParameters.ISA, --gpu-targets CLI flag, or amdgpu-arch gpu-probe subprocess). All three ISA entry-points are tagged separately with their source-category. No os.environ keys, no filesystem probes, and no asmCaps hardware capability flags participate in computing kernel[UseSubtileImpl]. The isgfx950 comparison is a pure Python equality on the IsaVersion namedtuple, not a hardware probe.
